store_listing_description.message:
Use your smart card, USB token, or OS certificate to sign on any website. Works with Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Opera, Brave and Safari on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Free and Open Source for everyone.

When a website asks for a signature, the WebeSign app opens its own window on your computer: you see who is asking, choose your certificate, check the verification code and confirm. Your PIN is typed in the app or in the operating system's window, never in a web page.

• Works with the certificates you already have: USB tokens, smart cards and certificates installed on your computer.
• The website sends only a fingerprint (hash) of the document; the document itself never leaves it.
• Every signature asks you first, and each website needs your permission, which you can revoke at any time.
• No account, no trackers, no background service and no open network port.

The extension works together with the free WebeSign app for Windows, macOS and Linux, available on the project website. Source code: GPL-3.0-or-later; developer libraries: Apache-2.0.
